segments.an3.29:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kareyya [phātikareyya (sī.)];
segments.an3.29:1.6: tathārūpampissa cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusalākusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajjānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.
segments.an3.29:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kareyya;
segments.an3.29:2.3: tathārūpaṃ panassa [tathārūpampissa (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusalākusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajjānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.
segments.an3.29:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya, adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kareyya;
segments.an3.29:3.3: tathārūpampissa cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusalākusale dhamme jāneyya;
segments.an3.29:3.4: sāvajjānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.
segments.an3.29:3.6: ‘Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmi’”nti.
segments.an3.29:5.3: Dhammādhammena saṭhoso [saṃsaṭṭho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), saṭhoti (ka.)],

lines: Navame cakkhu na hotīti paññācakkhu na hoti.
Kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgeti kaṇhasukkāyeva aññamaññaṃ paṭibāhanato paṭipakkhavasena sappaṭibhāgāti vuccanti.
Ayaṃ panettha saṅkhepo – kusale dhamme “kusalā dhammā”ti jāneyya, akusale dhamme “akusalā dhammā”ti jāneyya.
Kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgesu pana kaṇhadhamme “sukkasappaṭibhāgā”ti jāneyya, sukkadhamme “kaṇhasappaṭibhāgā”ti yena paññācakkhunā jāneyya, tathārūpampissa cakkhu na hotīti.
Na ceva bhogā tathārūpāti tathājātikā bhogāpissa na honti.
Na ca puññāni kubbatīti puññāni ca na karoti.
Ettāvatā bhoguppādanacakkhuno ca puññakaraṇacakkhuno ca abhāvo vutto.
Ubhayattha kaliggāhoti idhaloke ca paraloke cāti ubhayasmimpi aparaddhaggāho, parājayaggāho hotīti attho.
Atha vā ubhayattha kaliggāhoti ubhayesampi diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikānaṃ atthānaṃ kaliggāho, parājayaggāhoti attho.
Theyyena kūṭakammena, musāvādena cūbhayanti theyyādīsu ubhayena pariyesatīti attho.
Theyyena kūṭakammena ca pariyesati, theyyena musāvādena ca pariyesati, kūṭakammena musāvādena ca pariyesati.
Na socatīti yasmiṃ ṭhāne antosokena na socati. 10.

Navame andhotiādīsu pāḷipadesu paṭhamo diṭṭhadhammikabhogasaṃharaṇapaññācakkhuno ca samparāyikatthasādhanapaññācakkhuno ca abhāvā “andho”ti vuccati dutiyopi, tatiyo pana dvinnampi bhāvā “dvicakkhū”ti vuccati.
Tathājātikāti yādisehi saputtadāraparijanasañātimittabandhavaggaṃ attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti, tādisā bhogāpi na santi.
Puññāni ca na karotīti samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikayācakānaṃ santappanavasena puññāni na karoti.
Ubhayatthāti ubhayasmiṃ loke, ubhayasmiṃ vā attheti viggahoti dassento “idhaloke”tiādimāha.
Na socatīti sokahetūnaṃ tattha abhāvato na socati.
